name: Takazawa Masahiko
source:
A co-founder of Shirosawa Games who launched the company together with Shinjo.
A good friend of Shinjo's since college, he has served as the company president and game producer from the very beginning. He works in close partnership with Shinjo, the game creator, to develop games.
Despite AKIBA LOST being announced suddenly without his knowledge, he agrees to cooperate in the development of the game without getting angry, showing his trust and belief in Shinjo's talents.

[From in-game profile]
